verdict.rationale: Render's docs list a REST API section, and a probe confirmed a machine-readable OpenAPI spec is publicly served at render.com/openapi.json, so a documented public API exists for programmatic control. The webhooks, CLI and MCP evidence shows the platform is built for programmatic use but is not counted toward the API itself. missing for 10: detailed first-party evidence of API scope, endpoints and authentication; independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product through the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
